title: M5GFX #425: Panel_CVBS does not compile for esp32 on ESP-IDF v6.1.1 (DAC LL renames)

execution.environment: macOS arm64 host; Docker image espressif/idf:v6.1.1 (linux/arm64); IDF_INIT_VERSION 6.1.1; xtensa-esp32-elf-g++ 15.2.0; -std=gnu++26; minimal ESP-IDF app with M5GFX as a component; target esp32

checks.detail: idf.py build with espressif/idf:v6.1.1 for esp32 fails compiling lgfx_v1_platforms.cpp: 5 errors for dac_ll_digi_enable_dma, dac_ll_power_down, dac_ll_power_on, dac_ll_rtc_sync_by_adc at Panel_CVBS.inl:1976,1978,2037,2039,2040 on b48dce0
same five call sites and the same suggested replacements as the issue; line offsets differ because the report cites 0.2.36

v6.1 dac_ll.h declares dac_ll_power_on/power_down/rtc_sync_by_adc/digi_enable_dma; v6.1.1 declares dac_ll_pad_power_on/pad_power_down/pad_set_data_source/sync_by_adc/dma_clk_inv and no digi_enable_dma; IDF master has the same new names
v6.1 dac_ll_digi_enable_dma writes dac_dig_force and dac_clk_inv; v6.1.1 dac_common.c sets the data source and dac_dma.c calls dac_ll_dma_clk_inv, confirming the split
same 1057-step build completes; m5gfx425.bin 312304 bytes, sha256 553a7476027b1221092685286a9787d738c8cce535873465ed593711bf0ac03f
IDFBuild.yml matrix covers esp32 only up to IDF 6.0.2; no 6.1.x job, so green CI does not exercise this path
no hardware and no DAC/CVBS model; patch only proves the translation unit compiles and links
no esp32 board flashed or measured with composite video capture
Device Service esp32 profiles and esp-emulator have no ESP32 DAC/CVBS peripheral model; compile-time failure also blocks a runtime path before the fix
the < 6.1.1 branch keeps the original calls byte-for-byte; 6.1 and 6.0.2 were not rebuilt
only the ESP-IDF component build was tested

notes: Issue left OPEN; one English comment posted; no upstream code change, no push.
The fix uses ESP_IDF_VERSION >= ESP_IDF_VERSION_VAL(6,1,1) and keeps the original calls below that boundary.
CVBS output correctness after the API mapping is not verified; only compilation and linking are.
